118632.name: Chabad House of Western Michigan
118632.note: Detroit Jewish News, 9 Sept 1977: 'Grand Rapids Site of Second Chabad House Student Unit' - Chabad-Lubavitch of Michigan announces the opening of a new Chabad House in Grand Rapids, director Rabbi Yosef Weingarten of Brooklyn. (Corrected: the first pass had 'about 1979', counted back from 'about nine years ago' in 1988.) Where it has been (Jewish News): Sept 9 1977, 'The center is located at 1549 Michigan, near Plymouth Road, in the city's north-east section'; Dec 21 1979, 'New Chabad House Opens. Lubavitch has announced the opening of the Grand Rapids Chabad House, located at 1910 Michigan Ave. N.E.'; now 2615 Michigan Street NE (already its address in lubavitch.com's directory, Aug 2011).
